changes.reason: The description of admin_apply names the FortiADC table that Admin 1.0.10 supports: load-balance pool/pool_member with the key POOL:MEMBER (pool member state, add and remove). Arguments, input schema and result of admin_apply are unchanged; the other new Admin platforms (EOS, Cisco IOS and IOS XE, NX-OS, Junos) use the existing tools without a definition change.
